name: empirica
description: Host-neutral empirical-convergence workflow — binds exact claim scope, budgets and auditor to host-mediated approval (or explicit bounded auto), requires cited research before spikes, and gates convergence on a current independent audit. Unsupported approval and identity capabilities fail closed.

interface.longDescription: Adjudicate a claim graph with cited research, deterministic spikes, and independent audit before reporting convergence.
